newsitem.title: LESOTHO: Party defector to stay as Lesotho premier.
newsitem.headline: Party defector to stay as Lesotho premier.

text.p: Lesotho's Prime Minister Ntsu Mokhehle said on Monday he would carry on leading the mountainous southern African kingdom despite quitting the ruling party in a rift.
"There will be no change in the running of government since I still enjoy majority support of members of the national assembly," he told a news conference in the capital Maseru.

Earlier, a majority of the 65 members of parliament indicated their support for Mokhehle to stay on as premier, even though only around a third of them had defected to the new party he set up at the weekend.
Mokhehle was ousted as leader of the ruling Basotholand Congress Party (BCP) -- which dominates the assembly -- earlier this year after accusations the tiny state was drifting into lawlessness.
At the weekend he was voted leader of the new Lesotho Congress for Democracy Party by about 1,000 people in the capital Maseru.
